text.p: Here are the main headlines from the afternoon report of Lithuania's M1 Plus radio station. Reuters has not confirmed these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Lithuanian border police department told the ministry of foreign affairs that it did not ask the Belarus border police to take measures against the three employees of Russia's ORT television station who were arrested for filming in the border area. - Romualdas Ozolas, a deputy chairman of parliament, said that the ministry of European affairs should "put its arrogance aside" and cooperate with all political forces, rather than ignore a referendum on the privatisation of strategic enterprises.
